board: Joy-IT SensorKit KY-037 high-sensitivity microphone sound sensor (4-pin module: AO, G, +, DO)
reason: The check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run: the program printed the exact AO voltage and active-HIGH DO flag set on the controls, and the wiring, breadboard and DRC checks were clean. The AO/DO behaviour (LM393 comparator, inverted analog signal) comes from the Joy-IT KY-037 documentation.
